title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
title_zh: 回溯过去，迈向未来：面向长期规划智能体的回顾性探索与演化

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL , a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent’s knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL .

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly evolving from conversational systems into autonomous decision-making agents capable of solving long-horizon tasks through extended interactions, diverse tool use, and complex state transitions ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2026b ) . As task complexity increases, agents inevitably encounter unfamiliar constraints and make early mistakes that may alter the environment, trigger cascading failures, and accumulate irrelevant information into the context ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Recovering from such failures requires agents to revisit earlier viable environment states without discarding either valid progress or useful experience. Crucially, returning to an earlier state should not mean returning to the same decisions: agents must distill what they have learned from abandoned exploration and use it to guide a more informed continuation.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has sought to guide LLMs to recover from errors and learn from unsuccessful history through reflection, repeated trials, and backtracking. Interleaving reasoning with acting lets an agent revise its plan at each step, but the revision stays local and the execution keeps moving forward ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . Cross-episode adaptation uses accumulated experience to guide new attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , but applies it after an episode terminates and execution restarts from the initial state, requiring earlier progress to be repeated. Backtracking and trajectory-revision methods enable agents to reconsider earlier decisions through tree search, prompted controllers, or supervised correction traces ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . A central challenge is to train agents to proactively recover within an ongoing task and use the experience gained from abandoned branches to improve subsequent exploration. This calls for learning signals that improve both execution after a rewind and the experience carried forward.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究试图通过反思、反复尝试和回溯，引导大型语言模型从错误中恢复，并从失败的历史中学习。 将推理与行动交替进行，使智能体能够在每一步修正其计划，但这种修正仅限于当前步骤，执行过程则持续向前推进（Yao et al., 2023；Choi et al., 2026）。 跨回合适应利用积累的经验指导新的尝试（Shinn et al., 2023；Ouyang et al., 2026；Jiang et al., 2026），但必须在回合结束、执行从初始状态重新开始后才应用这些经验，因此需要重复早期的进展。 回溯和轨迹修正方法使智能体能够通过树搜索、提示控制器或监督修正轨迹重新考虑早期决策（Yuan et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026）。 一个核心挑战是训练智能体，使其能够在持续的任务中主动恢复，并利用从被放弃的分支中获得的经验来改进后续的探索。 这要求学习信号能够同时提升回溯后的执行效果，以及后续延续的经验质量。

paragraphs.en: Our key observation is that environment states can be rewound while the knowledge gained from exploration should be accumulated. An unsuccessful branch may reveal hidden constraints, ineffective actions, or promising alternatives, allowing the agent to revisit an earlier state with a better-informed context. We introduce ReTRAIL , a framework that exposes an environment-level rewind interface to the agent, allowing it to restore earlier environment states. Building on this interface, we propose Retrospective Exploration : the agent proactively leaves an unproductive branch, rewinds the environment to an earlier state, distills useful information from the abandoned branch into a compact reflection, and resumes execution with the preserved execution prefix and accumulated experience. To jointly develop the agent’s ability to rewind and distill useful experience from abandoned branches, we use State-Anchored GRPO to improve execution by comparing alternative continuations from the same environment state, and a branch-advancement reward to train reflection based on the relative progress of subsequent exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的关键观察是，环境状态可以被回滚，而通过探索获得的知识则应当被积累。 一个失败的分支可能会揭示隐藏的约束、无效的动作或有前景的替代方案，从而让智能体能够以更充分的信息背景重新访问先前的状态。 我们提出了 ReTRAIL——一个向智能体暴露环境级回滚接口的框架，使其能够恢复早期的环境状态。 基于这一接口，我们提出了“回顾性探索”：智能体主动离开无益的分支，将环境回滚到早期状态，从被放弃的分支中提炼出有用的信息并压缩为简洁的反思，然后保留原有的执行前缀和积累的经验，继续执行。 为了共同提升智能体回滚并从被放弃的分支中提炼有用经验的能力，我们使用“状态锚定 GRPO”通过比较同一环境状态下的不同后续路径来优化执行，并利用“分支推进奖励”基于后续探索的相对进展来训练反思能力。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ReTRAIL across four diverse interactive benchmarks: MineSweeper ( Li et al., 2024 ) , Sokoban ( Racanière et al., 2017 ) , ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , and ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . ReTRAIL achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods when rewind is enabled. Our experiments reveal that simply providing existing agents with a rewind operation does not consistently improve performance and can even degrade it. In contrast, ReTRAIL benefits from proactive rewinding across all four benchmarks and achieves further gains through reflection-guided retries. On MineSweeper, success increases from 58.8% without rewind to 63.5% with proactive rewinding, and reaches 95.3% with up to three reflection-guided attempts, compared with 70.8% for the strongest baseline under the same evaluation protocol. Further analysis shows that retry gains are larger on longer tasks and when abandoned branches reveal information useful for subsequent decisions. These findings highlight the value of learning to rewind and carry forward useful experience, enabling unsuccessful exploration to inform continued progress within an ongoing long-horizon task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个不同的交互式基准测试中评估了 ReTRAIL：扫雷（Li et al., 2024）、索科班（Racanière et al., 2017）、ALFWorld（Shridhar et al., 2021）和 ScienceWorld（Wang et al., 2022）。 在启用回退功能时，ReTRAIL 在所有被评估的方法中取得了最高的成功率。 我们的实验表明，仅仅为现有智能体提供回退操作并不会始终提升性能，甚至可能使其下降。 相比之下，ReTRAIL 在这四个基准测试中都能从主动回退中受益，并且通过反思引导的重试实现了进一步的提升。 在扫雷任务中，没有回退时的成功率为 58.8%，而采用主动回退后则提升至 63.5%；若最多进行三次反思引导的尝试，成功率可达 95.3%，相比之下，在同一评估协议下，最强基线模型的成功率仅为 70.8%。 进一步分析表明，在任务较长以及被放弃的分支揭示了有助于后续决策的信息时，重试带来的增益更大。 这些发现凸显了学习如何回退并保留有用经验的价值，这使得未成功的探索能够为长期任务的持续进展提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Sustaining reliable execution over long interaction sequences motivates research on planning, context management, and error recovery in LLM agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) . Search-based methods explore alternative action sequences within context ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . Agent-R learns decision correction from revision traces ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . However, revising decisions through context alone does not reverse changes to the environment, which can leave agents trapped in unproductive states. WebRollback uses action, critique, and rollback modules to select recovery points and carry forward experience summaries, with prompting and supervised fine-tuning from demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . GA-Rollback uses a prompted assistant to detect and localize errors during inference, restores earlier environment states through reset-and-replay, and retains error feedback to guide subsequent actions ( Li et al., 2025 ) . ReTRAIL take a step forward to train a shared execution and reflection policy that couples environment-level rewind with reinforcement learning, enabling more diverse exploration and more effective interaction budgets using.
paragraphs.zh: 在长期交互序列中维持可靠的执行，推动了 LLM 智能体在规划、上下文管理和错误恢复方面的研究（Yao 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2023；Yuan 等人，2025）。 基于搜索的方法会在上下文中探索替代的行动序列（Zhou 等人，2024；Choi 等人，2026）。 Agent-R 通过修订痕迹学习决策修正（Yuan 等人，2025）。 然而，仅通过上下文来修正决策并不会逆转环境的变化，这可能导致智能体陷入无益的状态。 WebRollback 使用行动、批评和回滚模块来选择恢复点并保留经验摘要，同时结合提示和基于演示的监督微调（Zhang 等人，2026）。 GA-Rollback 利用经过提示的助手在推理过程中检测和定位错误，通过重置与重播恢复早期的环境状态，并保留错误反馈以指导后续行动（Li 等人，2025）。 ReTRAIL 更进一步，训练了一种共享的执行与反思策略，将环境级别的回滚与强化学习相结合，从而实现了更多样化的探索，并更有效地利用了交互预算。

paragraphs.en: Adapting from interaction experience enables LLM agents to improve their behavior in unfamiliar tasks and environments. Reflection and memory mechanisms distill past trajectories into feedback and reusable strategies that guide subsequent decisions ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond memory accumulation, EvoTest and Meta-TTL adapt prompts, memory, and tool-use routines from episode feedback ( He et al., 2026c ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . Recent work further uses reinforcement learning to optimize how agents explore and adapt from experience. LaMer and MR-Search train exploration and post-episode reflection through meta-reinforcement learning, using discounted outcome reward to provide feedback for adaptation ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Learning to Self-Evolve rewards context revisions according to downstream performance improvements ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . ReTRAIL brings experience-informed adaptation into recovery within an ongoing task. By revisiting earlier environment states while preserving valid progress and distilled branch experience, agents can revise their exploration before the current attempt terminates, with subsequent branch progress providing a learning signal for reflection.

paragraphs.en: We formalize Retrospective Exploration , in which an agent rewinds to an earlier environment state while preserving the execution prefix and retaining experience from abandoned branches. We first introduce agent interaction and multi-episode adaptation, then describe how an environment-level rewind interface enables experience-informed recovery within an ongoing task.

paragraphs.en: ReTRAIL provides an environment-level rewind interface that allows the agent to restore a previously visited state during an ongoing attempt. When the current branch is unlikely to yield further progress, the agent can proactively rewind, preserve the execution prefix, and use experience distilled from the abandoned branch to guide a new continuation. paragraphs.en: Retrospective exploration allows agents to revisit earlier states and continue with accumulated experience. Learning to use this capability effectively requires improving both execution decisions and the experience distilled from abandoned branches. It therefore yields two complementary learning signals. First, alternative continuations from the same environment state and retained prefix can be compared to identify more productive execution paths. Second, the progress of a resumed continuation can be compared with that of the abandoned suffix to assess the usefulness of the experience carried forward.
paragraphs.zh: 回顾性探索允许智能体重新访问早期的状态，并基于积累的经验继续执行。 要有效利用这一能力，需要同时改进执行决策以及从被放弃的分支中提取的经验。 因此，这会产生两个互补的学习信号。 首先，可以从同一环境状态和保留的前缀出发，比较不同的后续路径，以识别更具成效的执行路线。 其次，可以将恢复后的后续进展与被放弃的后缀部分进行比较，以评估所延续经验的有效性。

sents.zh: 回顾性探索允许智能体重新访问早期的状态，并基于积累的经验继续执行。

sents.en: Learning to use this capability effectively requires improving both execution decisions and the experience distilled from abandoned branches.

paragraphs.en: We use these two signals to jointly train a shared execution and reflection policy. State-Anchored GRPO implements the first comparison by assigning credit to continuations from the same state and retained prefix. A branch-advancement reward implements the second by measuring the progress of the resumed continuation relative to the abandoned suffix. Figure 2 illustrates these two learning signals.

paragraphs.en: Reflection is generated from an abandoned branch, but its value is realized only through the continuation that follows recovery. The discarded suffix may contain useful information about invalid actions, hidden constraints, or promising alternatives; however, the final trial outcome is too coarse and too delayed to determine whether this information improved the resumed exploration. A successful trial may succeed despite an uninformative reflection, while a useful reflection may produce measurable progress before task completion. We therefore evaluate reflection by comparing the progress of the post-recovery continuation with that of the abandoned branch from the same restored state.
paragraphs.zh: 反思生成于一个被放弃的分支，但其价值只有通过恢复后的延续才能实现。 被丢弃的后缀可能包含关于无效操作、隐藏约束或有前景替代方案的有效信息；然而，最终试验的结果过于粗略且延迟太久，无法确定这些信息是否改进了恢复后的探索。 一次成功的试验可能在反思无用的情况下依然成功，而一次有用的反思则可能在任务完成前带来可衡量的进展。 因此，我们通过比较恢复后延续的进展与来自同一恢复状态的被放弃分支的进展来评估反思的价值。

paragraphs.en: ReTRAIL achieves the highest T@1 and T@3 on all four benchmarks (Table 1 ), outperforming the strongest baseline in T@3 by 24.5 24.5 percentage points on MineSweeper and 10.2 10.2 on ScienceWorld. Its forward-only P@1 remains competitive, slightly exceeding the strongest baseline on MineSweeper, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld, while trailing GiGPO by 2.3 2.3 points on Sokoban. Together, these results show that ReTRAIL’s advantage becomes more pronounced when recovery is enabled, while its forward-solving ability remains competitive.
paragraphs.zh: ReTRAIL 在全部四个基准测试中（表 1）都取得了最高的 T@1 和 T@3，在 MineSweeper 上其 T@3 比最强的基线模型高出 24.5 个百分点，在 ScienceWorld 上高出 10.2 个百分点。 其仅向前推理的 P@1 表现依然具有竞争力，在 MineSweeper、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上略高于最强的基线模型，但在 Sokoban 上比 GiGPO 低 2.3 个点。 综合来看，这些结果表明，当启用恢复功能时，ReTRAIL 的优势会更加明显，而它的正向推理能力依然保持竞争力。

paragraphs.en: ReTRAIL benefits from recovery both within and across macro-attempts. Within a single attempt, proactive recovery yields positive gains on every benchmark, ranging from 1.3 1.3 percentage points on ALFWorld to 10.9 10.9 on Sokoban, whereas enabling rewind for baseline policies produces mixed changes. Across attempts, ReTRAIL further improves with reflection-guided recovery and retained experience. On MineSweeper, success rises from 63.5 63.5 at T@1 to 95.3 95.3 at T@3, a gain of 31.8 31.8 points, compared with 9.1 9.1 for GiGPO and 13.6 13.6 for LaMer. These results demonstrate ReTRAIL’s ability to adapt through recovery, benefiting from both within-attempt course correction and continued exploration after failure.
paragraphs.zh: ReTRAIL 能够从单次宏尝试内部以及跨宏尝试的恢复中获益。 在单次尝试中，主动恢复在所有基准测试上均带来积极提升：ALFWorld 上提升 1.3 个百分点，Sokoban 上提升 10.9 个百分点；而允许基线策略进行回滚则会产生混合效果。 跨多次尝试而言，ReTRAIL 通过反思引导的恢复和保留的经验进一步提升了性能。 在 MineSweeper 中，成功率从 T@1 时的 63.5% 提升至 T@3 时的 95.3%，增加了 31.8 个百分点，而 GiGPO 和 LaMer 的提升分别为 9.1 个百分点和 13.6 个百分点。 这些结果表明，ReTRAIL 能够通过恢复机制进行自适应，既受益于单次尝试内的路线修正，也受益于失败后的持续探索。

paragraphs.en: Learning to recover from unproductive exploration is crucial for autonomous agents to make sustained progress on long-horizon tasks. We introduced ReTRAIL , a framework that combines execution recovery with experiential learning through retrospective exploration. With an environment-level rewind interface, agents can revisit earlier states and explore alternative continuations while retaining experience from abandoned branches. ReTRAIL trains a shared execution and reflection policy under this protocol, using state-anchored comparisons to improve execution and branch-advancement feedback to guide reflection. Across four interactive benchmarks, ReTRAIL consistently outperforms both methods without rewind and baselines equipped with the same interface, with ablations supporting the complementary roles of recovery, retained experience, and progress-based feedback. More broadly, these findings highlight retrospective exploration as a promising foundation for autonomous agents that can recover from setbacks, adapt through accumulated experience, and sustain progress toward long-horizon goals.

paragraphs.en: This work studies recovery and learning in autonomous agents through experiments on four controlled benchmark environments: MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld. The framework aims to improve agents’ ability to recover from unproductive exploration, but state restoration in these environments should not be interpreted as reversing the consequences of actions in real-world systems. Deployment beyond these benchmarks should therefore include appropriate authorization, safeguards for external actions, and human oversight where actions may have consequential or irreversible effects. Retained interaction histories and reflection memories should be handled with appropriate privacy and access controls, and any reuse or release of data, models, and software should respect their applicable licenses and terms of use.

Section 5.1 and Appendix C document the benchmarks and data partitions, baseline configurations, training hyperparameters, reward and progress signals, evaluation protocols, model-call accounting, and aggregation across benchmarks and seeds. Appendix E provides execution and reflection prompt templates and examples of observation formatting for the four benchmark environments.

paragraphs.en: Our results motivate two directions for extending retrospective exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果为扩展回顾性探索提出了两个方向。

paragraphs.en: The current framework assumes access to state restoration through snapshots or reset-and-replay; the latter requires deterministic transitions and resettable external state (Appendix D.1 ). Extending recovery to environments with approximate restoration or irreversible side effects is an important next step. Future work could explore restoration controllers and compensating actions, together with checks on the recovered state, to determine when earlier progress can be safely reused.
paragraphs.zh: 当前框架假设可以通过快照或重置与重播来恢复状态；后者需要确定性转移和可重置的外部状态（附录 D.1）。 将恢复能力扩展到具有近似恢复或不可逆副作用的环境，是下一个重要的步骤。 未来的工作可以探索恢复控制器和补偿动作，并结合对恢复后状态的检查，以确定何时可以安全地重用早期的进展。

paragraphs.en: ReTRAIL combines task-wide execution feedback with branch advancement, an environment-progress proxy for the utility of retained experience. The current execution return ends at each rewind boundary, while subsequent advancement supervises reflection (Appendix D.6 ). This design motivates studying credit assignment ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) across recovery boundaries, so that rewind timing and target selection can receive direct feedback from the resumed branch. Accounting for restoration and reflection costs, and developing progress estimators for settings with sparse or noisy feedback, could further broaden the framework’s practical use.
paragraphs.zh: ReTRAIL 将任务范围内的执行反馈与分支推进相结合，后者是衡量保留经验效用的一种环境进展代理指标。 当前的执行回报在每个回溯边界处终止，而随后的推进则负责监督反思过程（附录 D.6）。 这种设计促使我们研究跨恢复边界的信用分配问题（Wang et al., 2026b; Wang et al., 2026a），以便回溯时机和目标选择能够从恢复的分支中获得直接反馈。 若能将恢复与反思的成本纳入考量，并为反馈稀疏或存在噪声的场景开发进展估计器，将进一步拓展该框架的实际应用范围。
